accounting.priority: Left to right ordered slots; first eligible art only

core.description: Three barriers, venom and a telegraphed burst. Preparation reduces incoming damage 10%.
core.name: Core Trial Guardian

bridge_plated.description: The narrow crossing favors a damage channel that bypasses armor.
bridge_plated.name: Bridgeback Sentinel

bridge_veiled.description: For two seconds of each six, mist reduces physical damage and raises resistance.
bridge_veiled.name: Mistwing Crane

bridge_warded.description: Four barrier layers absorb direct hits. Sword removes two at once.
bridge_warded.name: Sealwing Crane

cleft_channeler.description: The warning pulse precedes a heavy strike. Protection has a six-second window.
cleft_channeler.name: Hollow Bell Keeper

cleft_keeper.description: Reflection punishes rapid direct hits; four layers must still be broken.
cleft_keeper.name: Cleft Keeper

cleft_thorned.description: Direct hits return 3 damage. Flame ticks do not trigger reflection.
cleft_thorned.name: Briarback Tortoise

cleft_warded.description: A layered seal guards the pass. Repeated strikes open it.
cleft_warded.name: Cleft Sealkeeper

cloud_sentry.description: Five barrier layers precede alternating mist protection. Multi-hit tempo matters.
cloud_sentry.name: Cloud Sentry

ford_channeler.description: Three calm attacks hide a stronger channeled release.
ford_channeler.name: Flood Bell Keeper

ford_plated.description: Eight armor makes unrefined physical pressure expensive.
ford_plated.name: Fordstone Sentinel

ford_venomous.description: A fresh venom refreshes duration without adding another stack.
ford_venomous.name: Waterline Serpent

ford_watcher.description: Strong venom during charges. River cleanses; River Silk reduces poison pressure.
ford_watcher.name: Ford Watcher

lotus_healer.description: Steady recovery exposes a build that spends all focus on defense.
lotus_healer.name: White Lotus Mender

lotus_veiled.description: Protected and open intervals alternate predictably, never granting immunity.
lotus_veiled.name: Moonmist Crane

lotus_warded.description: Six barrier layers reward a multi-hit opener.
lotus_warded.name: Pool Sealkeeper

lotus_warden.description: Four layers and 6% healing every six seconds reward sustained offensive focus.
lotus_warden.name: Lotus Warden

reed_guardian.description: Poison and periodic recovery test cleansing without abandoning pressure.
reed_guardian.name: Reed Guardian

reed_healer.description: Restores 8% HP every six seconds. Sustained damage must exceed recovery.
reed_healer.name: Lotus Mender

reed_scout.description: Cross the first shallows to discover a cleansing art.
reed_scout.name: Reedwater Scout

reed_venomous.description: Venom ticks each second for six seconds. River Confluence removes it.
reed_venomous.name: Jade Reed Serpent

steps_channeler.description: The bell brightens two seconds before its burst. Ward protects the release.
steps_channeler.name: Bellstone Adept

steps_plated.description: Thick stone plates blunt each physical hit. Flame passes through armor.
steps_plated.name: Mossback Sentinel

steps_scout.description: A measured first opponent. Basic strikes and Sword share the work.
steps_scout.name: Cloudpath Scout

stone_guardian.description: Armor and a telegraphed burst reward Flame with either focus or endurance.
stone_guardian.name: Stone Gate Guardian

earth.description: A shield absorbing a charged hit refunds 2 focus once per charge. Poison and reflections do not trigger it.
earth.name: Earth Accord

fire.description: Sword against a burning target adds one indirect 35% attack hit per cast. Never refreshes burn or triggers itself.
fire.name: Fire Accord

water.description: A real River cleanse grants a 10% HP shield for 3s. No poison removed means no shield.
water.name: Water Accord

endurance.description: Healing +15%; endurance crossings restore 25% HP instead of 15%. Consumed once on Depart.
endurance.name: Lotus Broth

storm.description: Charged damage −15% for this route. Consumed once on Depart.
storm.name: Grounding Tea

tomb.description: Attack +10% for this route. Consumed once on Depart.
tomb.name: Cinnabar Incense

realm_requirements.capability: Fourth ordered technique slot; reversible laws remain free.

broken_ford.description: Fordstone Sentinel · Waterline Serpent · Flood Bell Keeper · Ford Watcher
broken_ford.name: Broken Ford

buried_sun.hint: Direct hits reflect. Burn avoids reflection; recovery supports a direct build.
buried_sun.name: Buried Sun

cloud_bridge.description: Sealwing Crane · Bridgeback Sentinel · Mistwing Crane · Cloud Sentry
cloud_bridge.name: Cloud Bridge

hermits_cleft.description: Briarback Tortoise · Cleft Sealkeeper · Hollow Bell Keeper · Cleft Keeper
hermits_cleft.name: Hermit’s Cleft

lotus_pools.description: Pool Sealkeeper · Moonmist Crane · White Lotus Mender · Lotus Warden
lotus_pools.name: Lotus Pools

mirror_shore.hint: Defenses alternate every 6s. Mix physical and magic, or use sustained burn.
mirror_shore.name: Mirror Shore

moonless_crossing.hint: Endurance: HP carries between fights; recover 15% maximum HP at each crossing.
moonless_crossing.name: Moonless Crossing

reed_shallows.description: Reedwater Scout · Jade Reed Serpent · Lotus Mender · Reed Guardian
reed_shallows.name: Reed Shallows

silent_gate.hint: Barriers delay direct hits. Sword breaks layers; Returning refunds focus.
silent_gate.name: Silent Gate

stone_steps.description: Cloudpath Scout · Mossback Sentinel · Bellstone Adept · Stone Gate Guardian
stone_steps.name: Stone Steps

storm_ascent.hint: Charges every 10s. Interrupt, or absorb them with Ward.
storm_ascent.name: Storm Ascent

thunder_crown.hint: Fast strikes between charges. Protection or recovery keeps you grounded.
thunder_crown.name: Thunder Crown

flame.description: 60% attack magic; then 40% each second for 4s. Refreshes, never stacks.
flame.name: Crimson Flame

mirror.description: 18% HP shield for 4s. One absorbed strike retaliates for 120% attack magic; indirect damage never counters.
mirror.name: Mirror Counter

returning.description: Two 70% physical hits. Breaking a barrier refunds 2 focus once per cast (maximum 3 with Seal Needle).
returning.name: Returning Blade

river.description: Cleanse poison/burn and heal 20% maximum HP.
river.name: River Confluence

thunder.description: Interrupt one charge within 2s of release; 100% attack magic. Basic attacks continue.
thunder.name: Thunder Step

ward.description: Shield 30% HP for 6s. Times protection before charges; otherwise triggers below 65% HP.
ward.name: Jade Ward

burst_trial.description: Endure three bursts; shield at least one and retain 25% HP.
burst_trial.name: Burst Defense

earth_heir.description: Interrupt or shield at least one charged strike, then win.
earth_heir.name: Earth Inheritance

fire_heir.description: Use Flame and Sword or Returning in the same fight, then win.
fire_heir.name: Fire Inheritance

focus_trial.description: Win in 45s. Focus cap 6; recovery base 0.25/s; total skill budget 12.
focus_trial.name: Limited Focus

mixed_trial.description: Three finite encounters: barriers, poison, then burst. Camp between counters.
mixed_trial.name: Three Currents

moon_heir.description: Two encounters; HP carries with 15% recovery. Finish with at least 25% HP.
moon_heir.name: Moon Inheritance

poison_trial.description: Survive 30s and cleanse poison at least twice.
poison_trial.name: Poison Survival

reflection_trial.description: Skills only: no basic strike. Win with at most 30 reflected damage.
reflection_trial.name: Reflected Damage

soul.description: Three continuous stages: charge, barrier, alternating venom. Build changes apply at each boundary.
soul.name: Nascent Soul Tribulation

thunder_heir.description: 24 focus total. Answer a charge through interruption or protection, then win.
thunder_heir.name: Thunder Inheritance

tomb_heir.description: Break nine layers and win within 24 focus. Returning refunds or Sword conserves casts.
tomb_heir.name: Tomb Inheritance

ward_trial.description: Break nine barrier layers and win within 60s.
ward_trial.name: Ward Breaking

water_heir.description: Remove poison twice with River, then win. Choose offense or protection as companions.
water_heir.name: Water Inheritance
